key.name: enable-window-list
key.description: Whether to show the window list at the bottom of the screen.

key.name: enable-bottom-overview
key.description: Whether pushing the pointer against the bottom of a monitor toggles the overview.

key.name: enable-panel-free
key.description: Whether to hide the top panel except in the overview.

key.name: enable-light-style
key.description: Whether to switch the default style of the shell to light. A dark style chosen in the system settings still takes precedence.

key.name: grouping-mode
key.description: Decides when to group windows from the same application on the window list. Possible values are “never”, “auto” and “always”.

key.name: display-all-workspaces
key.description: Whether to show windows from all workspaces or only the current one.

key.name: show-on-all-monitors
key.summary: Show the window list on all monitors
key.description: Whether to show the window list on all connected monitors or only on the primary one.

key.name: embed-previews
key.summary: Show workspace previews in window list
